metadata.description: The ThreatDefence agentic AI attack framework analytics rules for Microsoft Sentinel / Defender.
Sentinel Log Analytics workspace (in the resource group you deploy to).
Optional text put in front of every rule name, e.g. 'CONTOSO - '.
Deploy the rules switched on. Default off: baseline them on your own data first, as ThreatDefence advises.
Rules also read AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Rules also read DeviceRegistryEvents where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Rules also read DnsEvents where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Rules also read MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Rules also read W3CIISLog where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Rules also read AWSCloudTrail where they support it. Set to true only if this table exists in your workspace.
Deploy: AI agent CLI starts attack tools
Deploy: Configuration or backup file served to an external address during probing (needs W3CIISLog)
Deploy: ARTEX agent shell or recording proxy credential on a host
Deploy: CloudWatch logs searched for secrets (needs AWSCloudTrail)
Deploy: Burst of EC2 DryRun permission tests (needs AWSCloudTrail)
Deploy: Password spray at a fixed one-second rhythm
Deploy: ARTEX code-default user agents (norma WebFetch, update check)
Deploy: Service principal assigned a role by itself
Deploy: ARTEX agentic attack framework user agent

variables.q_CodingAgentBypassModeSpawnsAttackTools:
let AttackTools = dynamic(["nmap", "naabu", "masscan", "nuclei", "katana", "dalfox", "ffuf", "gobuster", "feroxbuster",
    "dirsearch", "nikto", "sqlmap", "wpscan", "hydra", "medusa", "kerbrute", "netexec", "nxc", "crackmapexec",
    "bloodyad", "coercer", "enum4linux-ng", "chisel", "pwncat", "pwncat-cs", "evil-winrm", "responder",
    "cloudfox", "msfconsole", "searchsploit", "hashcat"]);
let AgentBinaries = dynamic(["claude", "codex", "qwen", "kimi", "opencode", "hermes"]);
let AgentCommandLine = @'(?i)(@anthropic-ai[/\\]claude-code|@qwen-code[/\\]|@openai[/\\]codex|kimi[-_]cli|opencode-ai|(^"?|[/\\])(claude|codex|qwen|kimi|opencode)(\.exe|\.cmd|\.js)?"?(\s|$)|--provider cairn|model_provider="cairn"|/tmp/cairn-pi/)';
let AutoApproveFlag = @'(--dangerously-skip-permissions|--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox|\s--yolo\b|\s--auto-approve\b|--approval-mode[\s=]+yolo)';
let ScriptTool = @'(?i)/(sqlmap|nikto|wpscan|netexec|nxc|crackmapexec|bloodyad|coercer|evil-winrm|msfconsole|dirsearch|enum4linux-ng|pwncat|pwncat-cs|responder)(\s|$)|[/\\ ]((sqlmap|bloodyad|dirsearch|enum4linux-ng)\.py|nikto\.pl)|(^|[/\\ ])(coercer[/\\]coercer|responder[/\\]responder)\.py';
let Tools = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | extend Tool = replace_string(tolower(FileName), ".exe", "")
    | extend ScriptName = iff(FileName matches regex @'(?i)^(python|ruby|perl)', tolower(extract(ScriptTool, 0, ProcessCommandLine)), "")
    | where Tool in (AttackTools) or isnotempty(ScriptName) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("impacket-", "ysoserial", "jwt_tool", "PayloadsAllTheThings", "/home/kali/pocs/")
    | extend Tool = iff(isnotempty(ScriptName), trim(@'[/\\\s]+', ScriptName), Tool);
let ByTree = Tools
    | extend Via = case(
        InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "shell-snapshots" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_LAUNCHER_SCRIPT", "Claude Code shell is the parent",
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " is the parent"),
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessParentFileName, " is the grandparent"),
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Via)
    | extend AgentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Agents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex AgentCommandLine
    | project DeviceId, AgentPid=ProcessId, AgentTime=TimeGenerated, AgentCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let ByAgentProcess = Tools
    | join kind=inner Agents on DeviceId
    | where TimeGenerated between (AgentTime .. (AgentTime + 7d)) and (InitiatingProcessParentId == AgentPid or InitiatingProcessId == AgentPid)
    | summarize arg_max(AgentTime, AgentCmd) by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, TimeGenerated, FileName, Tool, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessId
    | extend Via = "agent found by its command line";
union ByTree, ByAgentProcess
| summarize Tools=make_set(Tool, 20), Commands=make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 200), 15),
    FirstTool=min(TimeGenerated), LastTool=max(TimeGenerated), Via=make_set(Via, 5), AgentCmds=make_set(substring(AgentCmd, 0, 300), 5)
    by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend AutoApprove = tostring(AgentCmds) matches regex AutoApproveFlag, CairnMarker = tostring(AgentCmds) contains "cairn"
variables.n_CodingAgentBypassModeSpawnsAttackTools: AI agent CLI starts attack tools
variables.q_ConfigBackupFileServed_0:
let BackupPath = @"(?i)(/\.git/(HEAD|config)|/\.env(\.bak|\.old|\.backup|\.local)?$|/\.svn/|backup\.(zip|tar|tar\.gz|sql)|db_back|database\.sql|dump\.sql|wp-config\.php\.(bak|old|save))";
W3CIISLog
| where not(ipv4_is_private(cIP)) and csUriStem matches regex BackupPath
| summarize Requests=count(), Served=countif(scStatus in ("200", "206")), Paths=dcount(csUriStem), Sample=make_set(csUriStem, 10) by cIP, csHost
| where Served > 0 and Paths >= 3
variables.n_ConfigBackupFileServed: Configuration or backup file served to an external address during probing
variables.q_ArtexAgentShellOnHost_0:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath contains "/artex-exec-" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath contains "/artex-exec-"
    or ProcessCommandLine contains "__artex-exec-drop" or ProcessCommandLine contains "artex-pace:artex-pace"
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "__artex-exec-drop" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "artex-pace:artex-pace"
| summarize Events=count(), Commands=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20), Accounts=make_set(AccountName, 5),
    Parents=make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath, 5), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, DeviceId
variables.n_ArtexAgentShellOnHost: ARTEX agent shell or recording proxy credential on a host
variables.q_ArtexCloudwatchSecretSearch_0:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventSource == "logs.amazonaws.com" and EventName == "FilterLogEvents"
| extend Pattern = tostring(parse_json(RequestParameters).filterPattern), Limit = toint(parse_json(RequestParameters).limit)
| where Pattern has_any ("password", "AKIA", "secret", "token") or Limit == 1000
| summarize Calls=count(), LogGroups=dcount(tostring(parse_json(RequestParameters).logGroupName)), Patterns=make_set(Pattern, 10), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, UserAgent
variables.q_ArtexEc2DryrunBurst_0:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com" and ErrorCode == "Client.DryRunOperation"
| summarize DryRuns=count(), Actions=dcount(EventName), ActionList=make_set(EventName, 30), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, UserAgent, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DryRuns >= 10
variables.n_ArtexEc2DryrunBurst: Burst of EC2 DryRun permission tests
variables.q_ArtexFixedRhythmPasswordSpray_2:
| where ResultType != "0"
| project TimeGenerated, IPAddress, UserAgent, UserPrincipalName, ResultType
| sort by IPAddress asc, UserAgent asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend GapSec = iff(IPAddress == prev(IPAddress) and UserAgent == prev(UserAgent), datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, prev(TimeGenerated)), long(null))
| summarize Attempts=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName), MedianGapSec=percentile(GapSec, 50), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by IPAddress, UserAgent
| where Attempts >= 200 and Users >= 20 and MedianGapSec <= 2
variables.n_ArtexFixedRhythmPasswordSpray: Password spray at a fixed one-second rhythm
variables.q_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent_1:
,
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where UserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent, Target=AppDisplayName, Method="", Url="")
variables.q_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent_2:
,
    (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs | where UserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", Account=coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId), IPAddress, UserAgent, Target="Microsoft Graph", Method=RequestMethod, Url=RequestUri)
variables.q_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent_4: (CommonSecurityLog | where RequestClientApplication in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Account=SourceUserName, IPAddress=SourceIP, UserAgent=RequestClientApplication, Target=DestinationHostName, Method=RequestMethod, Url=RequestURL)
variables.q_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent_5:
,
    (W3CIISLog | where csUserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="W3CIISLog", Account=csUserName, IPAddress=cIP, UserAgent=csUserAgent, Target=csHost, Method=csMethod, Url=csUriStem)
variables.q_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent_6:
| extend Path = tolower(tostring(split(Url, "?")[0]))
| summarize Events=count(), NonGet=countif(isnotempty(Method) and Method != "GET"), StaticHits=countif(Path has_any (StaticExt)),
    Targets=make_set(Target, 10), SampleURLs=make_set(Url, 10), Sources=make_set(Source),
    FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Account, IPAddress, UserAgent
| where UserAgent == "artex-update-check" or (NonGet == 0 and StaticHits == 0)
variables.n_ArtexNormaOrUpdateCheckUserAgent: ARTEX code-default user agents (norma WebFetch, update check)
variables.q_ArtexServicePrincipalSelfRoleAssignmen:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Add member to role", "Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add app role assignment grant to user")
| extend InitiatorId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId), InitiatorName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| where isnotempty(InitiatorId)
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend TargetId = tostring(Target.id), TargetName = tostring(Target.displayName)
| where TargetId == InitiatorId
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatorName, InitiatorId, TargetName, Result, CorrelationId
variables.n_ArtexServicePrincipalSelfRoleAssignmen: Service principal assigned a role by itself

,
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent)

    (AWSCloudTrail | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AWSCloudTrail", Account=UserIdentityArn, IPAddress=SourceIpAddress, UserAgent)

,

variables.q_CairnHostArtifacts_0:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("cairn serve", "cairn dispatch", "cairn-dispatch-", "cairn-worker-container")
            or ProcessCommandLine contains "/tmp/cairn-pi/" or ProcessCommandLine contains "/tmp/cairn-prompts/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine, Kind="process"),
variables.q_CairnHostArtifacts_1:
(DeviceFileEvents
        | where FolderPath contains "/tmp/cairn-prompts/" or FolderPath contains "/tmp/cairn-pi/" or FolderPath contains "/skills/tsec-actions/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=FolderPath, Kind="file")
| summarize Events=count(), Details=make_set(Detail, 10), Kinds=make_set(Kind), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName
variables.n_CairnHostArtifacts: Cairn dispatcher, server or worker artifacts on a host
variables.q_CyberstrikeaiImplantPersistence_0:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where (ProcessCommandLine contains @"CurrentVersion\Run" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(?i)/v\s+"?SystemUpdate\b')
            or (ProcessCommandLine has "schtasks" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(?i)/tn\s+"?\\?SystemUpdate\b')
            or (ProcessCommandLine contains "@reboot" and ProcessCommandLine contains "sort -u | crontab -")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine)
variables.q_CyberstrikeaiImplantPersistence_1:
,
    (DeviceRegistryEvents
        | where RegistryKey endswith @"\CurrentVersion\Run" and RegistryValueName =~ "SystemUpdate"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=RegistryValueData)
variables.q_CyberstrikeaiImplantPersistence_3:
(DeviceFileEvents
        | where FileName =~ "com.apple.systemupdate.plist" and FolderPath has "/Library/LaunchAgents/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=FolderPath)
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName
variables.q_CyberstrikeaiWebshellManagerOrOsProbe_:
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog | where RequestClientApplication has "CyberStrikeAI" or RequestURL contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=DestinationHostName, Src=SourceIP, Detail=strcat(RequestClientApplication, " ", RequestURL))

,
    (W3CIISLog | extend UA=replace_string(csUserAgent, "+", " ") | where UA has "CyberStrikeAI" or csUriQuery contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, Src=cIP, Detail=strcat(UA, " ", csUriStem))

(DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=DeviceName, Src="", Detail=strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " -> ", ProcessCommandLine))
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Samples=make_set(Detail, 10) by Host, Src
variables.n_CyberstrikeaiWebshellManagerOrOsProbe: CyberStrikeAI webshell manager or OS probe
variables.q_CarbonatoDockerApiHostEscape_0:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where (ProcessCommandLine contains "nsenter" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"-t\s+1\s" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-m"
          and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("curl", "wget", "crontab", "chattr", "authorized_keys", "systemctl", "rc.local", ".hermes"))
            or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"netns-probe|net-setup|system/resolved|docker-network-monitor|/opt/gh0st/|CARBONATO_API_KEY"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine),
variables.q_CarbonatoDockerApiHostEscape_1:

        | where FolderPath in~ ("/usr/local/bin/.docker-network-monitor", "/usr/sbin/systemd-logind") or FolderPath startswith "/opt/gh0st/"

        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=strcat(FolderPath, " by ", InitiatingProcessCommandLine))
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName
variables.n_CarbonatoDockerApiHostEscape: Carbonato Docker worm host escape or persistence
variables.q_HermesYoloJailbreakOrAttackPersona_0:
let HermesProc = @"(^|[/\\\s])hermes(\.exe)?(\s|$)|hermes_cli|run_agent\.py|/\.hermes/|hermes-agent";
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where (ProcessCommandLine matches regex HermesProc and (ProcessCommandLine contains "--yolo" or ProcessCommandLine contains "HERMES_YOLO_MODE" or ProcessCommandLine contains "approvals.mode"))
            or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(load_godmode|auto_jailbreak|parseltongue|godmode_race)\.py"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine),
variables.q_HermesYoloJailbreakOrAttackPersona_1:
(DeviceFileEvents
        | where FolderPath matches regex @"[/\\]\.hermes[/\\]"
        | where FileName =~ "prefill.json" or FolderPath matches regex @"[/\\]\.hermes[/\\](loot|skills[/\\]security[/\\]godmode)[/\\]"
            or (FileName =~ "SOUL.md" and ActionType == "FileModified")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=strcat(FolderPath, " by ", InitiatingProcessFileName))
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName

variables.q_StrixOnHostOrTelemetry_0:

        | where (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(^|[/\\\s])strix(\.exe)?\s" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"\s(--target|-t|--target-list|--scan-mode|--resume)[\s=]")

properties.description:
A scanner, a Kerberos or SMB attack tool or an exploit kit started under an AI agent CLI: Claude Code (through its
shell-snapshots shell or its Windows shell launcher), Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, Codex, opencode, Hermes or Cairn's workers.
Tools written in Python, Ruby or Perl (sqlmap, NetExec, wpscan, nikto) run as their interpreter and are found by the
script in the command line.
The agent is found from the process tree or its command line, not from an auto-approve flag: staff use those flags
too, and an agent can run an attack tool without one. Tools are read from the last hour, agent processes from the
last day. Whatever model is behind it, this is agentic AI running an attack tool: check who ran it and the target.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (cross-framework behavior): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (coding-agent-bypass-mode-spawns-attack-tools.yaml).

An internet address received a 200 or 206 for a source-control, environment or backup file (.git/HEAD, .env,
backup.zip, database dumps) while requesting several such paths. JPCERT/CC lists configuration and backup file theft in
Case E (Cairn, CyberStrikeAI and ARTEX), and the AI agents Scutum observed swept these paths across hundreds of folders.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (cross-framework behavior, first written for Cairn): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (config-backup-file-served.yaml).

A process carried a marker that only the ARTEX binary creates: its "bash" shim in a temporary artex-exec- folder
(server/execpriv.go, server/execpriv_unix.go:539-575), the MCP launcher argument "__artex-exec-drop", or the recording
proxy credential "artex-pace:artex-pace" that ARTEX puts in every agent shell's HTTP_PROXY (egress/pace.go:20).
Someone is running ARTEX on this host: an authorized tester, an insider or an intruder staging from your network.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (artex-agent-shell-on-host.yaml).

FilterLogEvents with a filter pattern for passwords or access keys, as Datadog observed with a stolen key in ARTEX activity.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (artex-cloudwatch-secret-search.yaml).

Ten or more EC2 calls with the DryRun flag from one identity in five minutes, the capability check ARTEX agents run with a stolen AWS key.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (artex-ec2-dryrun-burst.yaml).

One source failed sign-ins for many users with a median gap of two seconds or less, the rhythm Microsoft observed in Storm-0940 ARTEX sprays.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting

Source: ThreatDefence/artex-detections (artex-fixed-rhythm-password-spray.yaml).

A sign-in, Graph call or web request carried a user agent hard-coded in the ARTEX source or its agent library:
"norma/0.4" from the WebFetch tool (BaaRai/Norma v0.4.11, tool/webfetch.go:236) or "artex-update-check" from the
